g.text: (d) The controlled repeat that would make (a) an interval

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: F1. The envelope of panel (a) is ONE retraining pair on ONE configuration on ONE stack (D2 arm H, seed 42, identical arguments). It cannot separate rank-specific variance from

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: stack non-determinism, architecture or schedule, and it is drawn as a single observation, not as an estimated distribution: no confidence band is shown because none has been

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: measured. Statistic R1 (Roy & Vetterli order-1, centred), block confound-residualised for every D2 and D1-B point and RAW for the Phase 1b point - and the Phase 1b arms were

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: never verified matched (draft 3.4). Panel (b)'s x-axis is a ratio of two R1 values within one comparison; no two rank statistics share an axis anywhere in this figure. The claim

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: does not rest on this figure alone: F2 reaches the same conclusion from 8 within-arm degrees of freedom without using the 2.69x number. Panels (b) and (c) sit side by side

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: because the channel is quoted as a paired within-run difference and rank is not - there is no paired form of "this run has higher rank".
